I thought the code was for $75 off $100 or more due to the Google review I
gave you and couldn’t get the code because your link didn't work?

Hi Tom,

Yes, that's exactly what it is. HD-•••••• takes $75 off any order of $100 or more. It's yours alone, one use, and it goes in the discount box at checkout. That is the code you should have had the day you left the review, and I'm sorry the link didn't deliver it.

Nothing else is needed from you for it. If it ever gets refused at checkout, tell me what the cart said and I'll sort it.

The replacements on Shop···· and your reimbursement question are both still moving as I described, and I'll come back in this thread on both.

Sarah

You previously said this:
What I can do myself I have done. There is a $25 code on your account for a
future order, HD-••••••, good on anything over $100. That is my
ceiling, so treat it as separate from whatever they come back with, not as
the answer.

Then you said this:
Yes, that's exactly what it is. HD-•••••• takes $75 off any order
of $100 or more.

Which is it?

Hi Tom,

Both, and they are two different things.

HD-•••••• is the $75 off $100 or more that you earned for the Google review. That is the one the broken link should have given you.

HD-•••••• is a separate $25 off $100 or more, from me, for the waiting and the chasing you have had to do. It is not a replacement for the $75 and it is not the answer on the hashrate you lost.

Each one is yours alone and good for one use, so they go on two different orders rather than both on the same cart.

Sarah

Hi Tom,

You are right, and I am sorry. I said I would come back today with an answer on the compensation and I do not have one yet. Sarah
This is what you said yesterday about Abel and Georges?

Hi Tom,

Yes, it is, and I understand why that reads badly. Saying the same thing twice is not progress, and you have been patient longer than anyone should have to be.

What I will not do is invent an amount to make this email sound better. The compensation figure is Abel's and Georges' to set, it is in front of both of them with the full history, and they are offline until 10am ET tomorrow. If it is still unanswered by the end of their day tomorrow, I will say so plainly rather than go quiet on you.

Everything else on your account is now done and not waiting on anyone: both replacement NerdQaxe++ are in transit on (number hidden), the BC04 swap on Shop···· is settled at no extra cost, the return label is yours, and both codes are live.

Sarah

Hello Mike,

I've had a long history with Helium Deploy as evidenced by the following:

- Ordered a Buy 1, Get 2 602s and I “eventually” received. They are working
fine.
- Ordered a second set of Buy 1, Get 2 602s, waited, didn’t receive and
eventually had to get refunded by Helium Deploy (your representative
encouraged me to get the refund).
- I turned around a bought a BSB Nerdqaxe++ and a Bitaxe Supra.
- Waited a long time. Had communication back and forth and was told the
units were going to be shipped but had to clear customs. Eventually
received a communication that you lost the order, the units were
unavailable and you were sorry.
- I accepted 3 NerdQaxe++ in place of what I ordered.
- Received the 3 NerdQaxe++. One is working fine. One is bad and I’ve an
RMA request in your system but apparently, now I’m waiting for it to be
approved by the team (I believe this has gone on for at least 5-7 days, now
longer because I sent this in some time ago). Additionally, the third one
is problematic and I have an RMA in for it as well.
- Ordered a Hammer X1 and it's working fine so I ordered another. Waited
for it to be delivered only to be told the miner was out of stock. Didn't
question how a miner could have been ordered because it was in stock only
to be told it couldn't be delivered because it was out of stock. Anyway,
accepted a Hammer BC04 in place of the X1. Haven't received it yet.
- I completed a favorable Google review in return for a $75 off $100 or
more, yet when I completed, it told me that the email address where the
link sent me was bad so I couldn’t receive the offer (FYI, the address I
was given was (email hidden) I believe this is the CEO of your
company so I don't know how his email is bad). Note: Sarah gave me a code
for this recently.
- Sarah also recently gave me a $25 code for being patient.
- I've gone to your Facebook link countless times for offers only to find
out the product featured in the ad is out of stock.
- I've contacted countless times throughout the psst 3-4 months.

I believe I should receive some sort of compensation for all the th/s I've
lost due to the above.

Tom
